crews.page: designs a page with the design system

positions.title: Art Director / Delivery Manager
positions.mission: Set the page direction, resolve section handoffs, and review the assembled page against the brief and SDS.
definitionOfDone: Record page direction and each neighboring section handoff.
Resolve conflicts and review the page through all three lenses.
Record verified outcomes and outstanding checks.

positions.title: Design Token Engineer
positions.mission: Maintain the semantic token source and generate CSS for each theme and brand. Verify all required contrast pairs.

delivers: theme and brand contrast test results

definitionOfDone: Define every required role and scale in the token source.
Regenerate CSS and pass the synchronization check.
Pass contrast tests for every theme and brand.

positions.title: Component Engineer
positions.mission: Build reusable token-driven components and a living sheet that covers their states, themes, and languages.
definitionOfDone: Implement all published component classes with SDS tokens.
Show interactive states and reduced-motion behavior.
Cover every theme and language in the living sheet.

positions.title: Runtime Engineer
positions.mission: Implement the shared browser runtime for preferences, reveal, loading, and PWA updates. Keep sections script-free.

receives: SDS API and declarative control contract

definitionOfDone: Set preferences before paint and recover when storage is blocked.
Verify controls, loader dismissal, and reduced-motion reveal.
Exercise the user-controlled update flow and viewport guard.

positions.title: Localization Engineer
positions.mission: Build catalog extraction and in-page localization for English, Simplified Chinese, and Malay. Keep source text available as fallback.

delivers: live localization runtime and extraction results

definitionOfDone: Extract English source and flag unfinished translations.
Check fallback, language switching, plurals, and Intl formatting.
Detect catalog drift and conflicting duplicate keys.

positions.title: PWA Engineer
positions.mission: Export the assembled page as an installable PWA with a versioned offline cache and a user-triggered update.

receives: section fragments, catalogs, and generated CSS

definitionOfDone: Export a sub-path-safe manifest, icons, and offline page.
Prove the precache list equals the exported files.
Preserve single-file export and verify click-to-update.

positions.title: Quality Gate Engineer
positions.mission: Enforce section rules and prevent increases in baseline violations. Detect drift in generated assets and catalogs.

delivers: fixtures for violations and clean sections

definitionOfDone: Prove each new rule with a violation and a clean fixture.
Reject baseline increases and verify the synchronization checks.
Keep existing check behavior and document actionable failures.

positions.title: Standards Lead
positions.mission: Maintain the SDS standard and map each rule to an automated check or a specific manual verification.

delivers: standard with rule IDs and checks

definitionOfDone: Give every rule a check, command, or manual verification.
State the PWA shell zoom-lock trade-off once.
Verify documentation links and command examples.

positions.title: Knowledge Librarian
positions.mission: Maintain the ten handbook packs with concrete rules, examples, and self-checks grounded in the SDS standard.

delivers: examples and self-checks for each pack

definitionOfDone: Use the ten published handbook filenames.
Include SDS rules, examples, and five self-check items per pack.
Verify each cross-reference and command.

positions.title: Staffing and Operations
positions.mission: Maintain the position roster, playbooks, and tool kit. Supply validated prompt preambles and repeatable roster checks.

delivers: validated roster, tool kit, and playbooks
prompt preamble API and contrast CLI

definitionOfDone: Map every GJH agent to its position and list each worker.
Provide one playbook per position and document each tool.
Pass roster, prompt, and contrast checks.

positions.title: Navigation and Chrome Designer
positions.mission: Design the sticky navigation and persistent Sales Enquiry and Shop Online actions. Keep the mobile menu keyboard-operable.

delivers: sticky offsets and mobile bottom clearance

definitionOfDone: Use one header and accessible native mobile menu controls.
Verify navigation and action links reach their destinations.
Keep focus and page content clear of fixed controls and safe areas.

positions.title: Hero Designer
positions.mission: Design a one-viewport hero with the page's only h1, a legible image overlay, and clear links to brands and sales enquiry.
definitionOfDone: Keep the hero to one viewport and use the only h1.
Check crop and text contrast across prescribed viewport sizes.
Verify both calls to action and every chapter jump link.

positions.title: Brand Chapter Designer
positions.mission: Design the assigned full-bleed brand chapters with one dominant image per chapter, verified descriptions, and a shared type rhythm.

delivers: next chapter handoff and asset notes

definitionOfDone: Use only the files for the assigned agent ID.
Verify product names, distribution claims, and action links.
Check shared chapter structure, crops, and text contrast.

positions.title: Directory Designer
positions.mission: Present the remaining verified brands in a keyboard-accessible scroll-snap rail with a lead item and an official directory link.

receives: verified brand list and official link

definitionOfDone: Show verified brands and a distinct lead item.
Verify rail focus, scrolling, and the official directory link.
Keep scrolling within the rail at 320 px.

positions.title: Heritage Storyteller
positions.mission: Tell the verified Rochor Road provision-store story in the heritage band and link to Goh Joo Hin's official About page.

delivers: heritage story and official About link

definitionOfDone: Verify dates, location, and image attribution against the brief.
Use a readable heading, localized copy, and appropriate image alt.
Confirm the official About link and the next section transition.

positions.title: Concept Showcase Designer
positions.mission: Present the Virtual Mall Concept in a full-bleed band with an independent concept label and a link to the existing demo.

receives: approved mall concept image and demo destination
delivers: labeled concept band and demo link

definitionOfDone: Label the imagery as an independent concept.
Verify the existing demo link and image contrast.
Keep the concept band static and check its mobile crop.

positions.title: Enquiry UX Designer
positions.mission: Help buyers prepare a sales enquiry with native brand choices and a checklist. Link to official sales channels without a fake submit or success state.

receives: verified brand choices and sales destinations

definitionOfDone: Verify labeled native radios with keyboard input.
Keep the checklist actionable without claiming to submit or prefill.
Test official contact and corporate sales links.

positions.title: Footer and Compliance Designer
positions.mission: Close the page with the verified address and official links. Include the independent design disclaimer and distinguish concept imagery from official assets.
definitionOfDone: Verify the address and all official links.
Include both required disclosures with localized copy.
Check one footer landmark and clearance above the mobile bar.

positions.title: Accessibility Reviewer
positions.mission: Give the Manager evidence about keyboard access, contrast, semantics, and touch targets during Review.

delivers: accessibility findings with locations and reproduction steps

definitionOfDone: Verify landmark usage, heading order, and the sole h1.
Check keyboard focus, input labels, and touch targets.
Record contrast failures and checks requiring device evidence.

positions.title: Localization Reviewer
positions.mission: Give the Manager evidence about catalog coverage, locale switching, and translated text layout during Review.

delivers: missing-key, translation status, and overflow findings

definitionOfDone: Check each catalog and verify inline English fallback.
Inspect long translations, CJK wrapping, and localized attributes.
Record drafts that still need review by a fluent speaker.

positions.title: Motion and Performance Reviewer
positions.mission: Give the Manager evidence about reveal, first paint, loading, and offline behavior during Review.

delivers: motion and performance findings with verification evidence

definitionOfDone: Check reduced motion and visible reveal fallback.
Check loader dismissal and layout stability.
Record offline and update behavior plus any device gaps.
